result.rationale: The owner image shows compact feet with a raised metatarsal arch, clustered toe roots, and a short rear hallux. The V35 mesh stretched the digit rails and talons forward and aft. This study keeps the ankle, toe-root and proximal pivots seated, moves each distal bearing axis 20% toward its proximal axis, shortens non-bearing digit links/guards around their original joint axes, and raises the existing foot-owned passive rails into a shallow arch.
